# Permavia Landscapes

> Permavia Landscapes is a regenerative landscape and farm design company based in Hoima City, Uganda, serving Hoima, Masindi, Kikuube, Kagadi, Buliisa, Kampala and clients across East Africa. We design, build, maintain and teach landscapes that hold water, rebuild living soil, grow food and protect wildlife, using organic, nature-based methods only. The first 30-minute discovery call (on Webex) is free.

## Key facts
- Location: Hoima City, Uganda (serving Hoima, Masindi, Kikuube, Kagadi, Buliisa, Kampala and East Africa)
- Services: Regenerative Design; Installation of Regenerative & Community Development Projects; Farm Solutions; Maintenance; Education for Regenerative Design & Management
- Projects: Million Trees (Tree Nursery, Establishing); Permavia Farm (5-Acre Regenerative Farm, Planning); Permavia Academy (Learning Platform · permavia.edu, Early Stage)
- Methods: organic and nature-based only; no synthetic fertilisers or pesticides
- Opening hours: Mon to Sat, 8am to 6pm (EAT)
- Contact: phone/WhatsApp +256 700 000 000; email info@permavialandscapes.com; website https://www.permavialandscapes.com/
- Free discovery call: book at https://www.permavialandscapes.com/contact/#book

## Services
- [Regenerative Design](https://www.permavialandscapes.com/services/#design): Site assessment and a complete design for water, soil, plants and people.
- [Installation of Regenerative & Community Development Projects](https://www.permavialandscapes.com/services/#installation): Our crews build regenerative and community projects: earthworks, planting and water systems, done right.
- [Farm Solutions](https://www.permavialandscapes.com/services/#farm): Regenerative farm systems in line with permaculture: agroforestry, syntropic agroforestry, food forests and more.
- [Maintenance](https://www.permavialandscapes.com/services/#maintenance): Seasonal care that keeps your landscape healthy, productive and beautiful.
- [Education for Regenerative Design & Management](https://www.permavialandscapes.com/services/#education): Hands-on training in designing and managing regenerative land, skills your team can use the next day.

## Projects
- [Million Trees](https://www.permavialandscapes.com/million-trees/): A community tree nursery growing millions of trees for farms, homes and restoration sites across Africa.
- [Permavia Farm](https://www.permavialandscapes.com/permavia-farm/): A 5-acre living demonstration farm with food forests, water systems, farm-to-table dining and stays.
- [Permavia Academy](https://www.permavialandscapes.com/permavia-academy/): Practical regenerative training, online for reach and on-farm for depth, grounded in African reality.

## Guides (Regenerative Journal)
- [Harvesting Rain: Simple Water Systems for Ugandan Homes and Farms](https://www.permavialandscapes.com/blog/harvesting-rain-water-systems/): To get water through the dry season in Uganda, slow rainwater down, spread it out and sink it into the soil. Start with roof catchment (a 100 m² roof collects about 1,000 litres for every 10 mm of rain), add swales dug on contour to store water in the soil, and use ponds or infiltration basins where the land allows.
- [Why Landscaping Is More Than Just Beauty](https://www.permavialandscapes.com/blog/why-landscaping-is-more-than-just-beauty/): Regenerative landscaping keeps the beauty of a garden but makes it work for you: fruit trees, perennial vegetables and herbs feed your family, well-placed trees cool your home and block wind, and mulch and groundcover protect the soil, which lowers water, fertiliser and food costs over time.
- [Transforming Spaces: The Art of Green Design](https://www.permavialandscapes.com/blog/transforming-spaces-the-art-of-green-design/): Good green design starts by observing a site (sun, wind, water and how people move) before changing anything. Permaculture then organises the land into zones by how often you visit them, and agroforestry uses trees as the backbone, providing shade, fruit, fodder, timber and mulch while feeding and holding the soil.
